**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole cooked vegetables fall in the cut-vegetable range, so I use density 0.6 g/ml. 90 ml × 0.6 ≈ 54 g. Rounding up for four medium sprouts gives about 60 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Roasted Brussels sprouts ≈ 40 kcal/100 g. 60 g × 0.40 ≈ 24 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Four small sprouts at roughly 15–20 g each give about 60–80 g. A 60 g estimate with about 24 kcal is plausible for what is visible. The charred surfaces suggest little added oil, so no oil is included.
